proposal_1_stacked_ensemble.name: Stacked Ensemble Meta-Learner on Pareto Front
proposal_1_stacked_ensemble.source: Scientific Reports 2025 — state-of-the-art NBA tabular prediction
proposal_1_stacked_ensemble.description: Use GA-evolved top-5 Pareto-front models as base learners. Train a logistic regression meta-learner on out-of-fold predictions. Meta-learner learns optimal weights per model type and feature regime.

implementation.location: hf-space/app.py — add stacking layer after GA converges each cycle
implementation.base_learners: Top-5 Pareto-front models from current generation (diverse model types: xgboost + RF + ET + LGB + catboost)
code_sketch: top5 = pareto_front[:5]  # take diverse model types

proposal_1_stacked_ensemble.why_now: Fleet best 0.22262. Checkpoint threshold 0.21837. Gap=0.00425. Stacking -0.003 to -0.006 could cross threshold and trigger Supabase checkpoint.

proposal_2_mc_dropout.name: Monte Carlo Dropout RNN (Uncertainty-Aware Sequential Calibration)
proposal_2_mc_dropout.source: MDPI Jan 2026 — Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
proposal_2_mc_dropout.description: GRU/LSTM with MC Dropout for sequential probability calibration. Run N=100 inference passes with dropout active. Mean=probability, variance=uncertainty. Better ECE than single-pass XGBoost.
proposal_2_mc_dropout.constraints: GPU required — Kaggle Karpathy loop only. NOT for HF Space (CPU).

implementation.architecture: GRU(128) → Dropout(0.3) → GRU(64) → Dropout(0.3) → Dense(1, sigmoid)
implementation.input_features: Rolling 10-game sequence of Cat1-Cat15 engineered features
implementation.seed_to_hf: Use best Kaggle feature sets to seed S10/S15 GA init populations
